author: reek
body: Database layer for Market. Defines the schema (products, variants, users, orders, carts, sessions) and provides typed CRUD operations on top of Codex.Data's relational engine.

author: reek
body: This chapter defined its own table-def, with the field names TableDef stopped having. Schema defines table-def and this chapter already cites it, so the local copy was shadowing a working function with a broken one under the same name. Deleted rather than repaired: two definitions of table-def in one unit is the collision that let this drift out of sync unnoticed in the first place.
